pages.text: Remote block activator. Sneak-use a block to bind the Cursor to that position and face. Right-click in air or on a block to trigger a remote use on the bound target, as if you clicked it yourself.

Binding is same-dimension only and respects a configurable range. XP is consumed for long-distance clicks unless you are in creative. The item glows while bound. Sneak-use again on a new block to rebind.
